T1_field_aware.question: Does the typed-block STRUCTURE (not the classifier) carry the accuracy? Is 'Field-Aware' in the title supported?

verdict.explanation: Typed-block is +6.74 macro-F1 over flat with the SAME char-TF-IDF features and the SAME LinearSVC head (typed 72.7 vs flat 66.0, delta CI [6.7393, 6.7393]). The typed STRUCTURE alone -- not the classifier -- carries a large lift, so 'typed-block representation' is a sound headline and 'Field-Aware' in the title is well supported.
verdict.label: field-aware-strong

T2_self_supervised.question: Does self-supervised pre-training on benign logs add accuracy over an identical random-init embedding? Is 'Self-Supervised' in the title supported?

verdict.explanation: Self-supervised pre-training adds +41.85 macro-F1 over an identical random-init FastText (trained 65.1 vs random 23.3, delta CI [41.5235, 42.1755]). The benign-corpus pre-training clearly drives accuracy, so 'Self-Supervised' in the title is well earned.
verdict.label: self-supervised-strong

T3_ten_pct_trade.question: At the agreed 10% headline budget, does typed-TF-IDF stay ahead (sparse wins) or does FastText catch up (better story for us)?

verdict.explanation: Typed-TF-IDF reaches 74.4 at 10% vs proposed FastText 73.6 (delta +0.8). FastText essentially CATCHES UP at the recommended 10% operating point -- the strongest framing for us: at the headline budget the accuracy gap closes while FastText keeps the ~10-25x latency advantage. Lead the 10% headline with this.
verdict.label: fasttext-catches-up-at-10pct
